content: Hello! What can I help you with today?
Hi, I forgot my account password and need to reset it.
No problem. To begin, please go to the account login page and click on the 'Forgot Password?' link.
Okay, I see the link. Should I click it now?
Yes, please click it. You’ll be prompted to enter your registered email address.
I entered my email and got a code sent to my inbox.
Great! Please enter the verification code on the website to continue.
Done. Now it’s asking me to create a new password.
Go ahead and set a new password. Make sure it meets the security requirements listed.
I’ve set a new password and logged in successfully. Thanks for your help!
